title: Filter Resets to Page One
description: Land on page 3 of the unfiltered list, then filter down to a status with only a handful of matches, and you'd better not be stranded on a now-nonexistent page 3 staring at an empty table.
successCondition: Navigating to page 2 or later of the tracking table, then changing the status filter to a different value, resets the pagination back to page 1 automatically (the "Page X of Y" label reads page 1, and the table shows rows rather than being empty due to a stale out-of-range page number).
hints: The status filter's onChange handler explicitly calls setPage(1) alongside setStatus — confirm both actually happen together, not just the filter value changing.
Choose a status filter likely to have fewer total matches than your current page's offset would require, to make an unreset bug visibly produce an empty table.
